title: The Price of Awakening
summary: As the Three Primordial Thrones awaken, Ha-Jun undergoes the harrowing memory-sacrifice trial to fully integrate the Hourglass into his Sovereign Core.

panels.shot: the sky of tartarus cracking like black glass under red lightning
panels.action: Massive red fractal cracks run across the firmament of Tartarus as cosmic pressure builds to critical mass.
panels.prose_en: Massive red fractal cracks run across the firmament of Tartarus as cosmic pressure builds to critical mass.
panels.prose_hi: Jaise hi brahmandiya dabav mahatvapurn dravyamaan tak badhta hai, tarters ke aakash mein vishal lal bhagna dararen fail jaati han.

panels.shot: three titanic obsidian thrones descending from the dimensional rift
panels.action: Three colossal floating thrones of black bone, each three hundred feet tall, descend from the fractured clouds.
panels.prose_en: Three colossal floating thrones of black bone, each three hundred feet tall, descend from the fractured clouds.
panels.prose_hi: Kali haddiyon ke teen vishal tairte sinhasan, pratyek teen sau feet unche, khandit baadalon se utarte han.

panels.shot: tae-jun gripping ha-jun shoulder assessing the enemy fleet
panels.action: Tae-Jun's eyes flash gold: 'The Primordial Triumvirate... They are moving their main army toward the Earth Gate.'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Wo Tartarus chhod kar Earth pe invade karne ja rahe hain! We must seal the breach!

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun's eyes flash gold: 'The Primordial Triumvirate... They are moving their main army toward the Earth Gate.'.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun ki aankhen sone ki tarah chamakti han: 'aadim vijay... ve apni mukhya sena ko prithvi dwar ki or le ja rahe han.'

panels.shot: kuro spreading wings: 'ha-jun must achieve 85% synchronization first!'
panels.action: Kuro: 'You cannot fight the Triumvirate with an unbonded Hourglass! You must complete the soul-lock!'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Hourglass ko permanent bind karo, Ha-Jun! No matter the pain!

panels.prose_en: Kuro: 'You cannot fight the Triumvirate with an unbonded Hourglass! You must complete the soul-lock!'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro: 'aap bina bandhan wale ovarglas ke saath trimurti se nahin lad sakte! aapko sol-lock pura karna hoga!'

panels.shot: ha-jun kneeling in the center of the amphitheater with the hourglass
panels.action: Ha-Jun sits in the lotus position on the golden sand, placing the Hourglass upon his lap and closing his eyes.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun sits in the lotus position on the golden sand, placing the Hourglass upon his lap and closing his eyes.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun sunhari ret par kamal ki sthiti mein baithta hai, apni god mein ovarglas rakhta hai aur apni aankhen band kar leta hai.

panels.shot: golden and violet sand spiraling out of the glass around his body
panels.action: A cyclone of sparkling chronal sand erupts from the vessel, orbiting Ha-Jun's body like planetary rings.
panels.prose_en: A cyclone of sparkling chronal sand erupts from the vessel, orbiting Ha-Jun's body like planetary rings.
panels.prose_hi: Chamchamati kalanukramik ret ka ek chakravaat jahaj se nikalta hai, jo grahon ke chhalle ki tarah Ha-Jun ke shareer ki parikrama karta hai.

panels.shot: the price of the bond: streams of mortal memories projecting into the air
panels.action: Dozens of holographic memory bubbles drift into the air around him—past fragments of his mortal 17 years.
panels.prose_en: Dozens of holographic memory bubbles drift into the air around him—past fragments of his mortal 17 years.
panels.prose_hi: Darjanon holographic smriti bulbule uske charon or hawa mein bahte hain - uski mrityu ke 17 varshon ke ateet ke tukde.

panels.shot: bubble 1: first bike ride with tae-jun pushing from behind
panels.action: A sunny afternoon: 8-year-old Ha-Jun learning to ride a bicycle without training wheels while Tae-Jun runs alongside.
panels.prose_en: A sunny afternoon: 8-year-old Ha-Jun learning to ride a bicycle without training wheels while Tae-Jun runs alongside.
panels.prose_hi: Ek dhoop bhari dopahar: 8 varshiya Ha-Jun bina prashikshan pahiyon ke cycle chalana seekh raha hai jabki Tae-Jun uske saath daud raha hai.

panels.shot: the bicycle memory bubble popping into gray mist
panels.action: The bubble pops silently; the image evaporates into grey ash, permanently erased from Ha-Jun's brain.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Mera pehla bicycle... Who bought it? I... can't remember.

panels.prose_en: The bubble pops silently; the image evaporates into grey ash, permanently erased from Ha-Jun's brain.
panels.prose_hi: Bulbula chupchap futata hai; chhavi dhusar raakh mein vashpit ho jaati hai aur Ha-Jun ke mastishk se sthayi roop se mit jaati hai.

panels.shot: bubble 2: mom cooking kimchi stew in their warm kitchen
panels.action: The warm aroma of stew: their mother smiling, wiping flour on her apron as young Ha-Jun sneakily grabs a meatball.
panels.prose_en: The warm aroma of stew: their mother smiling, wiping flour on her apron as young Ha-Jun sneakily grabs a meatball.
panels.prose_hi: Stu ki garm sugandh: unki maa muskura rahi han, apne appran par aata ponchh rahi hain aur Chhota Ha-Jun chupchap ek meatball pakad leta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun tears rolling as he watches his mother's face fade away
panels.action: Tears stream down Ha-Jun's cheeks as his mother's smiling features dissolve into blank white light.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Mummy ka chehra... Please... Bas unki aawaz chhod do...

panels.prose_en: Tears stream down Ha-Jun's cheeks as his mother's smiling features dissolve into blank white light.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ke gaalon se aansu bahane lage aur uski maa ki muskurati hui visheshtayen kori safed roshni mein vilin ho gain.

panels.shot: tae-jun stepping forward wanting to stop the ritual in anguish
panels.action: Tae-Jun rushes toward the sand circle, reaching out: 'Ha-Jun, stop! You're losing your childhood! Don't do this for me!'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: HA-JUN RUK JAO!! MERI WAJAH SE APNI YAADEIN MAT KHO!!

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun rushes toward the sand circle, reaching out: 'Ha-Jun, stop! You're losing your childhood! Don't do this for me!'.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun ret ke ghere ki or daudta hai, aur kehta hai: 'Ha-Jun, ruko! aap apna bachpan kho rahe han! mere liye aisa mat karo!'

panels.shot: kuro blocking tae-jun with an outstretched wing
panels.action: Kuro stops Tae-Jun with a firm black wing: 'Don't insult his resolve, Tae-Jun. He is no longer the boy you left behind.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Wo Sovereign ban raha hai. Trust your brother.

panels.prose_en: Kuro stops Tae-Jun with a firm black wing: 'Don't insult his resolve, Tae-Jun. He is no longer the boy you left behind.'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ne Tae-Jun ko ek majboot kale pankh ke saath roka: 'uske sankalp ka apmaan mat karo, Tae-Jun. wah ab wah ladka nahin hai jise aapne peeche chhoda tha.'

panels.shot: bubble 3: the rainy day on the university roof in episode 1
panels.action: The memory of being beaten by bullies on the rain-slicked roof of Saint Mirren University.
panels.prose_en: The memory of being beaten by bullies on the rain-slicked roof of Saint Mirren University.
panels.prose_hi: Sent miren vishwavidyalaya ki baarish se bheegi chhat par dabangon dwara pite jaane ki smriti.

panels.shot: ha-jun commanding the hourglass: 'take my pain, take my humiliations!'
panels.action: Ha-Jun directs the vortex: 'Consume my weakness! Consume every moment I felt helpless and small!'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Meri kamzori, mera darr, meri bebasi... Yeh sab le lo!!

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun directs the vortex: 'Consume my weakness! Consume every moment I felt helpless and small!'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun bhanwar ko nirdeshit karta hai: 'meri kamjori ka upbhog karo! har us pal ka upbhog karo jab maine khud ko asahaay aur chhota mahsoos kiya!'

panels.shot: all memories of school bullying burning into black smoke
panels.action: The memories of bullies, beatings, and helpless crying are incinerated into pitch-black smoke and ejected into the abyss.
panels.prose_en: The memories of bullies, beatings, and helpless crying are incinerated into pitch-black smoke and ejected into the abyss.
panels.prose_hi: Badmashon, pitai aur asahaay rone ki yaadein gahre kale dhuen mein bhasm kar di jaati hain aur rasatal mein fenk di jaati han.

panels.shot: only the golden core memories remaining untouched in ha-jun soul
panels.action: Three unshakeable memories shine like diamonds in his chest: Tae-Jun's smile, Kuro's feather, and Min-Jae's loyalty.

dialogue.text: The core remained: Love, Brotherhood, and Honor.

panels.prose_en: Three unshakeable memories shine like diamonds in his chest: Tae-Jun's smile, Kuro's feather, and Min-Jae's loyalty.
panels.prose_hi: Teen atal yaadein uske seene mein heere ki tarah chamakti han: Tae-Jun ki muskan, Kuro ke pankh, aur min-je ki wafadari.

panels.shot: the hourglass dissolving completely into liquid starlight
panels.action: The brass casing of the Hourglass melts away; its golden sand fuses directly into Ha-Jun's solar plexus.
panels.prose_en: The brass casing of the Hourglass melts away; its golden sand fuses directly into Ha-Jun's solar plexus.
panels.prose_hi: Ovarglas ka pital ka aavaran pighal jata hai; iski sunhari ret sidhe Ha-Jun ke saur jaal mein vilin ho jaati hai.

panels.shot: an explosive shockwave of chronal mana blasting outward across tartarus
panels.action: A million-mile shockwave of compressed temporal mana expands outward, knocking the Three Thrones back in the sky.
panels.prose_en: A million-mile shockwave of compressed temporal mana expands outward, knocking the Three Thrones back in the sky.
panels.prose_hi: Sampidit asthayi man ki ek lakh meal ki shockwev bahar ki or failti hai, jo teen sinhasanon ko wapas aakash mein gira deti hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun floating three feet in the air surrounded by the ten relics
panels.action: Ha-Jun hovers weightlessly, surrounded by all ten Relics rotating in a magnificent planetary alignment.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun hovers weightlessly, surrounded by all ten Relics rotating in a magnificent planetary alignment.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ek shandar grah sanrekhan mein ghumte hue sabhi das avsheshon se ghira hua, bharahin roop se ghumta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun hair shifting: midnight-black streaked with platinum starlight
panels.action: Strands of his messy jet-black fringe turn radiant platinum-silver, catching the cosmic light like polished titanium.
panels.prose_en: Strands of his messy jet-black fringe turn radiant platinum-silver, catching the cosmic light like polished titanium.
panels.prose_hi: Uske gande jet-kale fringe ke strand chamakdar platinam-silvar mein badal jaate han, jo polish kiye gaye titanium ki tarah brahmandiya prakash ko pakadte han.

panels.shot: twin ethereal halos of eclipse flame igniting behind his back
panels.action: Two interlocking concentric halos of black and violet eclipse flame ignite behind his shoulder blades.
panels.prose_en: Two interlocking concentric halos of black and violet eclipse flame ignite behind his shoulder blades.
panels.prose_hi: Uske kandhe ke blade ke peeche kale aur baingani rang ki grahan lau ke do interlocking sankendrit prabhamandal prajvalit hote han.

panels.shot: ha-jun opening eyes: double eclipse rings spinning in irises
panels.action: Ha-Jun's eyes snap open: double crimson eclipse rings spin counter-clockwise inside brilliant violet pupils.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's eyes snap open: double crimson eclipse rings spin counter-clockwise inside brilliant violet pupils.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ki aankhen khul gain: dohre lal grahan ke chhalle chamakdar baingani putliyon ke andar vamavart ghumte han.

panels.shot: ha-jun dropping lightly onto his boots standing at full height
panels.action: Ha-Jun descends lightly to the sand; his coat settles smoothly, radiating an aura of total, effortless absolute dominance.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun descends lightly to the sand; his coat settles smoothly, radiating an aura of total, effortless absolute dominance.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun halke se ret par utarta hai; uska coat aasani se baith jata hai, aur sampurn, sahaj purna prabhutv ki aabha bikherta hai.

panels.shot: system notification window appearing before ha-jun in golden script
panels.action: A translucent golden interface appears: '[DEMON SOVEREIGN BLOODLINE SYNCHRONIZATION: 85.0% - TRUE MONARCH UNLOCKED]'.
panels.prose_en: A translucent golden interface appears: '[DEMON SOVEREIGN BLOODLINE SYNCHRONIZATION: 85.0% - TRUE MONARCH UNLOCKED]'.
panels.prose_hi: Ek parabhasi sunhara interface prakat hota hai: '[danav samprabhu raktarekha tulyakalan: 85.0% - sachcha samrat unlock]'.

panels.shot: tae-jun walking up to ha-jun smiling with profound pride
panels.action: Tae-Jun walks up, resting his hand on Ha-Jun's shoulder: 'You did it. You really became the True Sovereign.'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Tum sach mein Sovereign ban gaye, Ha-Jun.

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun walks up, resting his hand on Ha-Jun's shoulder: 'You did it. You really became the True Sovereign.'.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun Ha-Jun ke kandhe par apna haath rakhte hue aage badhta hai: 'tumne yah kiya. aap sachmuch sacche prabhu ban gye.'

panels.shot: ha-jun smiling warmly at tae-jun with clear, loving eyes
panels.action: Ha-Jun smiles back: 'I may have forgotten my middle school classes... But I could never forget my brother.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Main duniya ki har cheez bhool sakta hoon... Par apne bhai ko kabhi nahi.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun smiles back: 'I may have forgotten my middle school classes... But I could never forget my brother.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun jawab mein muskurata hai: 'ho sakta hai ki main apni middle school ki kakshayen bhool gaya hun... lekin main apne bhai ko kabhi nahin bhool sakta.'

panels.shot: kuro landing on ha-jun shoulder cawing with royal pride
panels.action: Kuro spreads his dark wings proudly: 'The army is assembled, My Lord. The Gate to Earth has been breached.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Three Void Thrones are descending on Seoul right now.

panels.prose_en: Kuro spreads his dark wings proudly: 'The army is assembled, My Lord. The Gate to Earth has been breached.'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ne garv se apne kale pankh failaye: 'sena ikatthi ho gai hai, hey prabhu. prithvi ka dwar tod diya gaya hai.'

panels.shot: ha-jun drawing sanguine fang pointing straight upward into the rift
panels.action: Ha-Jun points his blazing blood katana straight into the dimensional tear: 'We return to Earth. We end this war tonight.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Seoul wapas chalo. Earth ko bachane ka waqt aa gaya hai.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun points his blazing blood katana straight into the dimensional tear: 'We return to Earth. We end this war tonight.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun apne dhadhakte khoon katana ko sidhe aayami aansu ki or ingit karta hai: 'ham prithvi par lautate han. hum aaj raat is yudh ko samapt karte han.'

panels.shot: ha-jun and tae-jun leaping into the portal together cliffhanger
panels.action: Side by side, Ha-Jun and Tae-Jun vault into the blinding dimensional slipstream to defend Earth!

dialogue.text: ARC 8: THE MYTHIC AWAKENING — CONCLUDED. NEXT: ARC 9 — THE WAR OF SOVEREIGNS.

panels.prose_en: Side by side, Ha-Jun and Tae-Jun vault into the blinding dimensional slipstream to defend Earth!.
panels.prose_hi: Agal-bagal, Ha-Jun aur Tae-Jun prithvi ki raksha ke liye chakachaundh aayami slipstream mein kood padte han!
